units.text: I designed and built REST API with Python and FastAPI for partner integrations. Endpoints are versioned and there is OpenAPI specification. In 3 months 4 partners connected, no breaking changes.
I put 3 legacy services in Docker containers and moved them to Kubernetes on AWS. Database I replicated before. Cut-over took 20 minutes, customers saw no errors.
I wrote around 200 automated regression tests with pytest. I run them in GitLab CI on every merge request. Releases went from monthly to weekly and no rollbacks in 4 months.
